sentences.text:
Applicant :- Mohsin Khan
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Saurabh Yadav,Istyak Khan

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 30.01.2023 as well as cognizance in Criminal Case No. 75673 of 2023 (State Vs. Mohsin Khan)
arising out of Case Crime No. 7 of 2023 under Sections 498A, 323, IPC, 3/4 D.P. Act and 4 of Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019.

entities.text: Criminal Case No. 75673 of 2023 (State Vs. Mohsin Khan
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In the Court, learned counsel for the applicant only submitted that some direction be issued to the court concerned regarding bail as he wants to surrender before the trial court.

The application is, therefore, disposed of with the direction to the trial court that if the applicant appears before the trial court within 15 days from today and moves an application before the trial court, the same shall be disposed of as soon as possible in view of law laid down in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, (2021) 10 SCC 773.

sentences.text: As per report of Mediation Centre, the parties were not willing for the mediation and on all dates only applicant appeared.
The opposite party no. 2 did not appear before the Mediation Centre.
Hence, the amount deposited by the applicant may be returned to the applicant on his request.
